actions.message: Kirk Cousins for Alvin Kamara — you're all-in at RB (Gibbs/Robinson start, Kamara/Dowdle/Gainwell stacked behind them) but carrying zero backup QB in a superflex league. Cousins is the Raiders' clear starter. Kamara's playing well right now, but with Etienne down for a month there's only so much workload to go around once he's back.

evidence.note: Kamara scored twice on the ground in Week 4 and has moved into amandaberry's starting FLEX over Rico Dowdle, ahead of New Orleans' Week 5 game, with Travis Etienne still on IR.

actions.why: Kamara is leading NO's backfield with Etienne on IR and just scored twice — good value off a 4-QB bench even at a slightly higher price, but Cousins is now my live starter, not spare depth.
